title: MathformerPhysicsLib coherence and grounding loop
summary: Audit declarations, canonical concepts, Mathlib grounding, duplicate definitions, integration, API operability, generative probes, repair plans, and the coherence gate.

visible_workflows.description: Run deterministic and generative critics with repair evidence before claiming MathformerPhysicsLib coherence.
evidence_gates: python scripts/mathformer.py ask "audit MathformerPhysicsLib coherence and grounding" --run --json

composed_skills.role: Build declaration, import, and concept inventory.
Canonicalize detected physics concepts and ownership.
Audit Mathlib reuse before local support definitions.
Generate advisory probes that are bound back to deterministic evidence.
Gate coherence with deterministic findings and repair-plan evidence.

controlled_actions.role: Write JSON and Markdown coherence reports.

generated_skills.promotion_boundary: Generative probes remain advisory until deterministic gates bind their findings.

release_boundaries.rule: Generative coherence claims cannot block or promote without deterministic evidence.
Medium or high findings require repair actions or explicit blockers.

risk_controls.control: Quality card requires deterministic evidence bindings and rerun gates.
Coherence gate records repair status and property gate values.
